app.title: nerdz
app.subtitle: Decode like a robot.
stage.qr.0.title: Structure
stage.qr.0.short: Every QR code has three big corner squares and timing strips. Those help the scanner find the code from any angle.
stage.qr.1.title: Format & Mask
stage.qr.1.short: First the format bits are read, then a pattern is peeled away to reveal the real data hiding underneath.
stage.qr.2.title: Data Reading
stage.qr.2.short: A reader zig-zags across the code, collecting black-and-white squares into a long string of 1s and 0s.
stage.qr.3.title: Error Correction
stage.qr.3.short: Extra repair bits let the code work even when part of it is dirty or damaged.
stage.qr.4.title: Final Decode
stage.qr.4.short: Each 8 bits become a letter. Watch the hidden message appear!
scan.status.idle: Show a code to the camera
